words: Serverless SQL that scales to zero, copies itself in a second for every pull request, and has a console that's actually nice. Write any query below — it runs.
A full copy of your data for every pull request — without copying a byte.
Pay nothing while nobody's using it; wake up in under 300 ms.
Point-in-time recovery for the last 30 days.
Encrypted at rest and in transit, with IP allow lists and SSO.
A made-up database service. The SQL engine and data live in this page.

SELECT c.name, c.country, SUM(p.price * o.qty) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.name, c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(qty) AS items
FROM orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY orders DESC;

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(p.price * o.qty), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT name, category, stock
FROM products
WHERE stock < 25
ORDER BY stock;
